all.description: Plans from $15/mo. Save about 20% with annual billing.
all.markdown:
# Fieldnote pricing

## Pricing that grows with your crew

Every plan includes unlimited notes, photo capture and offline mode. Try any plan free for 14 days.

## Starter

For small crews getting organized.

$19/mo

$15/mo billed annually ($180/yr)

Up to 3 seats

[Start free trial](https://app.fieldnote.app/signup?plan=starter)

*   Unlimited notes and checklists
*   5 GB photo storage per seat
*   Email support

Most popular

## Pro

For growing teams that need workflows.

$49/mo

$39/mo billed annually ($468/yr)

10 seats included

[Start free trial](https://app.fieldnote.app/signup?plan=pro)

*   Everything in Starter
*   Custom forms and approval workflows
*   50 GB photo storage per seat
*   Priority chat support

## Business

For multi-site operations.

$99/mo

$79/mo billed annually ($948/yr)

25 seats included

[Start free trial](https://app.fieldnote.app/signup?plan=business)

*   Everything in Pro
*   SAML single sign-on
*   Audit log (1 year retention)
*   99.9% uptime SLA

## Enterprise

For regulated and large organizations.

Custom pricing

Unlimited seats

[Contact sales](https://www.fieldnote.app/contact-sales)

*   Everything in Business
*   Dedicated success manager
*   Data residency (EU, US, AU)
*   Custom contract and invoicing

## Add-ons

Need more people on Starter, Pro or Business? Add extra seats for $8/seat/mo, billed with your plan. Extra photo storage is $5 per 100 GB per month.

## Frequently asked questions

Can I switch between monthly and annual billing?

Yes. Switching to annual billing applies the discount from your next renewal. Annual plans are billed upfront for 12 months.

Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?

Registered nonprofits get 50% off Starter and Pro. Contact us with your registration details.

What happens when my trial ends?

After 14 days your workspace becomes read-only until you choose a plan. Nothing is deleted.
